item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"sequence_modeling","rationale":"Halve the configured causal context length, rounding up with a minimum of one interaction. Existing truncation retains the most recent interactions chronologically, and checkpoint metadata applies the same length during prediction across all four datasets. Shorter context may reduce stale preferences and runtime while preserving the GRU, readout, loss and optimizer.","edits":[{"find":"MAXLEN        = int(os.environ.get(\"GRU4REC_MAXLEN\", \"128\"))","replace":"MAXLEN        = max(1, (int(os.environ.get(\"GRU4REC_MAXLEN\", \"128\")) + 1) // 2)"},{"find":"    maxlen = int(meta.get(\"maxlen\", 128))","replace":"    maxlen = int(meta.get(\"maxlen\", 64))"}]}],"change_summary":"Reduce default causal context from 128 to 64 interactions for all four category models; preserve chronological ordering and synchronize the generated predictor fallback."}
